generate.help_character_file: Path to .voice.yaml (specify directly instead of by name)
generate.help_line: Line (Japanese; Tsukasa is a Japanese TTS)
generate.help_subtext: Subtext of the line (human override, optional)
generate.warn_ref_extend_add: or bin/reference.py add <wav> <key> (register a royalty-free source)

character.description: Define, validate, and list character voices.
character.template:
# {name} — character voice (character asset).
# Conforms to voice_profile.schema.json. reference_audio is a speaker key from the
# reference-voice library or an actual file path (path A: fixes timbre from this audio).
character: {name}
# reference_audio: female_young_p308   # example; pick a speaker key from the reference library
voice:
  age: young_adult      # child / adolescent / young_adult / adult / middle_aged / elderly
  gender: female        # female / male (used for prompt subject and reference-file-name detection)
  pitch: medium_high    # very_low / low / medium_low / medium / medium_high / high / very_high
  texture: soft         # soft / warm / clear / bright / dark / husky / breathy / neutral
  breathiness: slight   # none / slight / moderate / heavy
  resonance: head       # intimate / chest / head / nasal / bright / neutral

performance.description: Define, validate, and list performance directions.
performance.template:
# {name} — performance direction (performance asset).
# Conforms to performance_asset.schema.json. Only emotion is required; the rest are optional.
# situation/subtext feed Resolve (the LLM's subtext inference).
emotion: neutral       # anxiety / sadness / anger / fear / joy / confidence / loneliness / excitement / calm / guilt / neutral
# intensity: moderate  # none / subtle / moderate / strong / overwhelming
# volume: normal       # whisper / quiet / normal / loud / shout
# speed: natural       # very_slow / slow / natural / fast / very_fast
# pitch: natural       # very_low / low / slightly_low / natural / slightly_high / high
# breathiness: none    # none / slight / moderate / heavy
# delivery: controlled # restrained / subtle / suppressed / controlled / flat / gentle / intimate / aggressive / cheerful / cold / desperate / hesitant
# pause_before: 0.0    # seconds (pause before the line)
# situation: A late-night call. Anxious whether the other person is awake, but seeking connection.
# subtext: Afraid of the reply, but drawn toward connection.

reference.description: List and expand the reference-voice library.
reference.help_synthesize: Create reference audio via local synthesis (path B)
reference.help_syn_character: Character name (input voice attributes from voice.yaml)
reference.help_syn_line: Line for the reference (default is a greeting)
reference.err_need_voice: Specify voice attributes via --character or --gender/--age etc.
reference.synthesizing: Synthesizing (path B, no reference)… key={key} voice={voice}
reference.license_note: Note: when distributing, license attribution (e.g. VCTK is CC BY 4.0) is required.

distill.description: Distill audio assets (characters/performances) from bulk input.
distill.help_batch: One story text → multiple main characters × multiple key scenes
distill.help_synthesize: Also synthesize and register each character's source voice (path B)
distill.help_overwrite: Overwrite existing assets of the same name

route.duration_capped: [route] the requested {requested} s exceeds {provider}'s limit of {max} s; generating {max} s.

resolve.fallback: [resolve] LLM failed, falling back to Rule: {exc}
resolve.non_english_prompt: [resolve] the model prompt contains non-English text (the generators are English-only). Use --resolve llm to translate: {prompt}

scene.description: Synthesize multiple characters' lines into one WAV (scene).
scene.help_scene_file: Path to scene.yaml (character + line + direction + pauses)
scene.help_params: Path to a saved scene.params.yaml (regenerate, no LLM)

asset.description: Generate BGM, ambience, sound effects, and foley.
asset.help_sound: Sound Direction (repeatable; commas become a list)
asset.help_bible: Path to the Sound Bible (default: projects/<project>/sound-bible.yaml)

probe.description: Measure generated audio (a stand-in for listening).
probe.level: level peak {peak} / RMS {rms} dBFS / crest {crest} dB / DC {dc}
probe.bands: bands low {low} dB / mid {mid} dB / high {high} dB
probe.flag_bass_heavy: WARNING biased to low end (low exceeds mid by {diff_db} dB)
probe.flag_no_highs: WARNING almost nothing above 2 kHz ({level_db} dB)
probe.flag_head_step: WARNING starts at a non-zero sample ({value})
probe.flag_too_short: WARNING too short to measure bands ({samples} samples)
probe.burst: Burst {burst} dB (max minus median of the 10ms envelope; higher for one-shot hits)

library.description: Work with the reusable asset library.

sound_bible.description: Work with a project's Sound Bible.
sound_bible.valid_empty: The Sound Bible is empty (no section is set): {path}

act_probe.description: Measure one line as acting (pitch, range, rate, pauses, energy).
act_probe.pitch: pitch {f0} Hz / range {rng} semitones / ending {end} st/s
act_probe.energy: energy {med} dB (range {rng}) / attack {atk} ms / length {dur} s
